banner_text: Calm Magic — A framework for the agentic era
hero_subtitle: A Framework for Preferable Futures in the Agentic Era
hero_description: The era where relational intelligence, pragmatic imagination, creative ideation, and existential design become the most crucial capabilities to build preferable futures and worldbuilding initiatives.
thesis_title: Four capabilities for the agentic era
thesis_description: When agents do the doing, humans become responsible for the framing. Calm Magic names the four capabilities that matter most.
pillar_relational_desc: The capacity to hold creative tension, listen across difference, and build trust as infrastructure — not garnish.
pillar_imagination_desc: Disciplined speculation. Turning what-if into what-next without losing contact with reality, constraints, or stakes.
pillar_ideation_desc: Generating, combining and pruning options at the speed of agents — while keeping the human author in the loop.
pillar_existential_desc: Designing for meaning, not just utility. Choosing which futures deserve to exist and which patterns we refuse to repeat.
why_now_title: Agents reshape the work. Humans must reshape the why.
why_now_p1: Agentic systems compress the cost of execution. The bottleneck moves upstream — to intention, framing, and the worlds we are willing to build.
why_now_p2: Calm Magic is a methodology and a discipline for that upstream work. It treats organizations as living systems, decisions as worldbuilding moves, and the future as something we author rather than predict.
why_now_p3: This book is for founders, designers, coaches and operators who refuse to outsource meaning to a model.
chapters_description: Each chapter maps to a phase of the Calm Magic framework — from naming the glitch to operating in flow.
chapter_1_desc: Why the future arrives as a glitch first. Reading signals, holding tensions, refusing premature resolution.
chapter_2_desc: Wandering with discipline. Mapping possible and probable futures before committing to a preferable one.
chapter_3_desc: Choosing the future you'll author. Velocity = speed × direction toward what should exist.
chapter_4_desc: Trust, conflict, repair. How relational intelligence becomes the load-bearing wall of any agentic system.
chapter_5_desc: Worldbuilding as a leadership skill. Diegetic prototyping, narrative tooling, and existential design.
chapter_6_desc: From insight to ontology. Building the calm scaffolding that lets fast agents operate without breaking the team.
chapter_7_desc: When the framework dissolves into practice. Continuous reconfiguration, learning organizations, preferable futures shipped weekly.
playbooks_title: Three playbooks the book makes usable
playbooks_description: The book does not stop at theory. It gives leaders structured sequences for rupture, exploration, and alignment in live systems.
playbook_glitch_title: Work with rupture before anyone forces a fake answer
playbook_glitch_desc: For moments when something breaks trust, strategy, or coherence. These sequences slow the panic loop, name the fracture, and turn confusion into situated intelligence.
playbook_glitch_item_1: Surface the real tension instead of the socially acceptable version.
playbook_glitch_item_2: Map who is affected, what is threatened, and what must not be lost.
playbook_glitch_item_3: Convert friction into a decision frame strong enough for the next move.
playbook_drift_title: Explore patterns without collapsing into noise
playbook_drift_desc: For ambiguous terrains where teams need to wander with rigor. Drift sequences expand the field of signals, artifacts, and futures before narrowing too early.
playbook_drift_item_1: Gather weak signals, reference works, and edge-case behaviours worth tracking.
playbook_drift_item_2: Compare possible, probable, and preferable futures across contexts.
playbook_drift_item_3: Synthesize motifs that deserve prototyping, not just admiration.
playbook_tune_title: Commit with direction, not just momentum
playbook_tune_desc: For the moment after exploration when coherence matters. Tune sequences align intention, maturity, and delivery so teams move with informed velocity.
playbook_tune_item_1: Choose which future is being authored and why it deserves to exist.
playbook_tune_item_2: Match features, rituals, and governance to the organization's maturity.
playbook_tune_item_3: Translate insight into a roadmap teams can actually inhabit.
bridge_description: Crewdle uses Calm Magic as a preparedness audit and a maturity-based feature system — so the product knows what a team is ready for before it asks them to move faster.
bridge_left_desc: A relational and strategic audit of readiness: tensions, capacities, governance needs, and the level of coherence required to move without distortion.
bridge_right_desc: A fluid orchestrator that activates the right UX tactics, rituals, and agentic support based on maturity — not hype, not generic vibe-coding.
compare_title: What vibing tools avoid, Calm Magic makes explicit
compare_row_1_right: Preparedness audit of tensions, intent, and relational capacity.
compare_row_2_right: Maturity-based featuresets matched to what a team can metabolize.
compare_row_3_left: Fluid on the surface, fragile underneath.
compare_row_3_right: Super-fluid, informed design systems with governance built into the motion.
compare_row_4_right: Preferable futures with staying power, coherence, and live learning.
author_role: Founder, Paracosm · Practitioner of Calm Magic
author_bio: Jonathan is a strategic designer and leadership coach who has spent two decades helping founders, operators and organizations build preferable futures. He works at the intersection of relational intelligence, agentic systems, and worldbuilding — translating speculative thinking into shipped products and resilient teams.
author_work_title: Maps, systems, and field work behind the book
author_work_description: These living artifacts show the practical texture of Jonathan's work: transmedia mapping, innovation planning, and layered design systems already in motion.
author_work_card_1_desc: Layered worldbuilding and systems mapping across culture, ecosystem, behaviour, and technology.
author_work_card_2_desc: A spiral planning artifact linking Calm Magic, storytelling, publishing, and transformational design.
author_work_card_note: I also surfaced additional web references for Jonathan's practice and can turn approved ones into brand-safe assets next.
